name: Julia Savage
bio: Julia Savage was born in Sydney, Australia. In 2023 she was nominated for the Australian Academy of Cinema and Television Arts (AACTA) Award and the Australian Film Critics Association Award for Best Lead Actress in a Feature Film for 'Blaze' (2022) (Causeway Films) opposite Simon Baker and Yael Stone. In 2023 she appeared with Guy Pearce, Kate Mulvany and Miranda Otto in the eight-part psychological thriller 'The Clearing' (2023) for Wooden Horse/Egeria TV/ Disney+/Star Originals/Hulu and in the acclaimed all-female comedy series 'Class of '07' (2023) for Matchbox Pictures (Universal International Studios)/Prime Video. Julia appeared on BBCTV with Jim Sturgess and Teresa Palmer in the Irish/Australian co-production 'Mix Tape' for Foxtel Group, Aquarius Films/Subotica in 2025 and appears as Emma in the 2026 feature film 'Boss Cat' .

credits.overview: Set in 1780, Sweet Tooth is a dark and magical fairy tale film inspired by the classic story of Hansel and Gretel by the Brothers Grimm, but it is the untold story of the wicked witch and her infamous gingerbread house.
